note: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them. Hidden flags follow the hidden list published by EGamers and GTABase (28 hidden: 27 bronze, 1 gold). Targets are the counts PSNProfiles lists. Guides are written in our own words; each cites its sources by name.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. There is no separate task: follow the roadmap, finish the story, clear the collectibles and the grinds, and this lands last. PowerPyx puts the whole run at roughly 200 hours and 4 out of 10 difficulty, so treat this as the finish line, not a trophy to chase on its own.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission, and this pops. It is the first story trophy and cannot be missed: just play the opening through to its end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Story trophies pop as you play; chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the final cutscene, so do not worry if it lands a beat late.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. From this chapter Jason and Lucia are both playable, which opens most of the list: side activities, collectibles and stranger strands all start to unlock here, so explore between missions.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Keep playing the story; nothing here needs a special step, and the chapter's missions feed the story trophies that follow.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. The optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is...' opens the bank vaults, so take it while you are here: Maximum Withdrawal needs five vault robberies, and this is where that lane starts.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Keep a manual save at the start of the final stretch, as the guides recommend for any story trophy, then play the finale through to the credits.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks in the story and pops when the mission ends; there is no extra step.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 mission. It is story-related and unmissable: finish the mission and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story-related and unmissable: play the mission to its end.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story-related and unmissable: play the mission to its end.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Story-related and unmissable. The airport is also where Catch Me If You Can happens, so note the layout while you are here.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story-related and unmissable: play the mission to its end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The in-game checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) appears after the story, but earlier progress counts and nothing on it is missable. PowerPyx and GTABase both rank this the hardest trophy; the thresholds are lenient, PowerPyx puts it near 60% of true completion, and most of the work is already done by earning the other trophies first. Finish the story, clear the collectibles and grinds, then open the checklist and mop up what is left.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Any 250 of the 397 stunts in the state count, and the 100% checklist asks for 300, so the trophy lands first. Flying under bridges is reported as the quickest kind of stunt to repeat.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. You do not need to win or finish anything: one try of each type is enough. Work through the game's nine listed activity types once both characters are playable.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 challenges and every one needs gold: no silver will do. Practise each range until the gold time or score feels comfortable, then clear them one by one.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. PowerPyx counts 42 races across the 14 locations: you need a win at each place, not every race. Learn one fast line per location and repeat it until the win lands.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count, and the 100% checklist asks for 30, so the trophy comes first. Mix race types so you are not grinding one event over and over.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal and take him on at fishing: win the challenge and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Pick any arcade cabinet, play it through to the end, and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is one of the stranger mission chains: start it as soon as it unlocks, since one guide warns stranger chains have windows tied to story progress, and finish his last mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand is one of the stranger mission chains: start it as soon as it unlocks, since one guide warns stranger chains have windows tied to story progress, and finish his last mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand is one of the stranger mission chains: start it as soon as it unlocks, since one guide warns stranger chains have windows tied to story progress, and finish his last mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. There are more than 8 strands, so any 8 finished strands count. Start them early: one guide warns some chains have windows tied to story progress, so do not leave them all until after the credits.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand is one of the stranger mission chains: start it as soon as it unlocks, since one guide warns stranger chains have windows tied to story progress, and finish his last mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is one of the stranger mission chains: start it as soon as it unlocks, since one guide warns stranger chains have windows tied to story progress, and finish his last mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. This is the only trophy reported as possibly missable: Lucia's first meditation, on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, is reported to disappear once that chapter ends, and there is no mission replay. Do it in Chapter 1, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, and clear the other spots as you explore. Note the sources disagree on the count: PSN tracks 18, while one 100% checklist lists 15, so keep meditating until it pops.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand points you at one specific animal, but which animal it is has not been confirmed by the guides yet, so follow Bret's missions and take the hunt when it is offered rather than guessing at wildlife on your own.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; any 3 finished sets count, while the 100% checklist asks for 15 sets, so this is the early end of a long hunt. Collect as you travel rather than leaving it all to the end.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game scanning and sharing action: use it at 100 different spots around the state. The 100% checklist asks for the same 100, so this finishes alongside it if you scan everywhere you go.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives; any 50 count, and the 100% checklist asks for 70. Chip away at them between story missions instead of saving them for a final grind.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and leave the red heat zone. Both guides point to a train tunnel north of Ambrosia as a good escape, and bank vault robberies often bring the wanted level you need.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Hit three shops in a row while still wanted: the jewelry stores of North Vice City sit close together. If it does not pop after the third, GTABase says to rob a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. According to GTABase you scan 100 different vehicles with WAiNK: there is no need to drive them, and scanning traffic near busy roads is efficient.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Fill Focus before you start, use an assault rifle, and aim for gang members: cops, soldiers and civilians do not appear to count.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. GTABase reports the method: steal a docked passenger jet at the airport and fly about 1 km away from it.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. GTABase reports the method: steal a tank (a Rhino) from Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Open the store's back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code and clear out the safe without anyone spotting you.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults open after the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is...', after which you follow a security van into a bank while its vault is open. Any 5 of the 8 vaults count, and each escape brings 4 stars, so have a fast bike ready for the getaway.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find a truck on the road, hit it, grab the cash and get clear of the wanted level.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. This clears the fog across the whole map: flying over the dark patches is reported as the quickest method.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One robbery per gang: GTABase lists 9 gangs, and the trophy pops when the ninth is done.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact steps are not confirmed by any guide yet: PowerPyx marks this one as not yet known. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game: head to Ocean Beach, look for a bar with a view over the water, and order a cocktail there.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. GTABase thinks this means crashing a car out through a showroom window, but that is unconfirmed: PowerPyx marks it as not yet known. Try driving a car through a showroom's front window and out the other side.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl: the exact wording is unclear in the guides, so play a full game there and the trophy should pop.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. GTABase reports this means maxing out Strength for both characters, but that is a single source, so treat it as the best current lead: train both characters' strength to the top and watch for the pop.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. GTABase links this to 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile, but that is a single source. Play naturally and make profile-changing choices; the count climbs as you do. Check a Criminal Profile guide before going on a rampage, since one profile outcome is permanent.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. No guide has confirmed the trigger yet: PowerPyx marks it as not yet known. The name suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something, so keep playing and watch for a second-chance moment.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? No guide has confirmed the trigger yet: PowerPyx marks it as not yet known. GTABase thinks it refers to a strange event somewhere in Leonida, so explore odd spots and watch for something out of the ordinary.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The exact steps are unconfirmed, but the description is plain: knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills through fences: GTABase notes one fence pays the most, and the total grows during the 100% robberies. Keep laundering until the $250,000 mark is reached.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any spending counts: shops, clothes, food, gear. It adds up across the whole playthrough, so buy what you need as you go.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy the 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, around $160,000 in total. The 4 story garages do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find 10 vehicles and register each one in the app: any vehicles count.
